## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the plastic fan and set it on the Lime mat.

Task description: Move the white plastic fan in the middle of the table to the lime-green square mat on its left, meeting the target position and pose requirements, then release the gripper.

Success criteria: Place the fan near the center of the lime-green mat, close to its surface, with the required pose and orientation; both grippers must be open. The materials do not specify which part of the fan defines its reference position or which way its face should point, so neither the base center nor its current orientation can automatically serve as the criterion.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping the exposed section of the support below the fan head and above the base. Keep the pads clear of the fan guard, connecting joint, and lower edge of the base, leaving room for the base to contact the mat during placement.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected grasp section. Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on opposite sides, rather than overlapping in the image while pressing against the same side of the housing.
- The fan cover is wide. Leave clearance between its lower edge, base, and table while adjusting the pose, and watch its distance from the red object behind it, remote control, and rotation range to reduce collisions.
- Let the base rest on the mat before gradually opening the gripper. Withdraw in a direction clear of the fan guard and support structure, avoiding catching it with a finger and shifting or tipping it.
